text_to_image_prompt: Older adult man, neatly combed silver hair, narrow mature face and age lines, gray-green eyes, no glasses, black suit, gray waistcoat and tie, white shirt, black Oxford shoes, lean upper body and substantial natural legs. Six head-and-shoulder portraits in a 3 by 2 grid: left profile, front, right profile, left three-quarter, rear, right three-quarter. Pure white seamless studio background, soft even daylight, natural detailed skin and individual hair strands, accurate cloth weave and shoe leather, realistic photography, no text, no watermark. Maintain natural adult anatomy and consistent identity.
original_prompt: Create a photographic head-angle identity reference sheet of the EXACT SAME person in the references. Older adult man, neatly combed silver hair, narrow mature face and age lines, gray-green eyes, no glasses, black suit, gray waistcoat and tie, white shirt, black Oxford shoes, lean upper body and substantial natural legs. Reference 1 controls exact facial identity, age, facial proportions, hair and accessories. Reference 2 controls approved outfit and photographic style. Six equally sized close-up head-and-shoulder photographs in a tidy 3-column by 2-row layout on pure white: top row left-facing exact 90-degree profile, straight frontal eye-level, right-facing exact 90-degree profile; bottom row left three-quarter face, straight rear view of head and upper shoulders, right three-quarter face. Neutral relaxed mouth and eyes in all visible faces, no expression changes. Same scale and white studio lighting. Every head fully inside its cell with complete hair and ears, no overlap. Realistic fine skin texture, hair strands, natural cloth; no illustration, no waxy skin, no swirly false textures. No text, labels, numbers or borders. Preserve identity and hairstyle in all six angles. Landscape 3:2 sheet, maximum native resolution.
reproduction_note: 独立提示词为成图重建描述；严格身份一致需同时参考已确认全身图与原始肖像。实际尺寸按PNG记录，不冒称2K或4K；背面细节为生成补全。
